GizmondoDroid v0.3

- New game installer: "Install game" in the library installs a .zip (e.g. a Gizmondo game download), a single .exe, or a whole folder.
- Each installed game gets its own virtual SD card (its folder), so games with the same file names don't clash.
- Hold a game in the library to remove it.
- autorun.exe launchers are hidden from the library.
